test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Mr Ram invests an amount of ₹12,200 at the rate of 2% per annum for 4 years to obtain a simple interest .Later he invests the principal amount as well as the amount obtained as simple interest for another 4 years at the same rate of interest. What amount of simple interest will he get at the end of the last 4 years?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal = ₹12,200

Rate = 2%

Time = 4 year

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest = PRT / 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Simple Interest for first 4 years = PRT / 100

⇒ (12200 × 2 × 4) / 100 = ₹ 976

⇒ Total amount = ₹ 13176 (principal + Interest)

New principal = ₹ 13176

⇒ Simple Interest for last 4 years = PRT / 100

⇒ (13176 × 2 × 4) / 100

∴ **Simple Interest for last 4 years = 1054.08**
